name: @w6w-apps/twilio
description: Send SMS/MMS/WhatsApp messages and make phone calls via Twilio.

w6w.longDescription:
Twilio sends messages and makes calls from a workflow — one action covers SMS, MMS and WhatsApp, switching between them by sender and destination rather than requiring three separate actions, with media attachments supported for MMS. A second action places an outbound phone call.

The messaging action supports both a plain phone number sender and a Messaging Service SID — the pooled-sender setup Twilio's own A2P 10DLC registration attaches to — so a workflow can use whichever a Twilio account is actually configured with.

A fit for sending transactional notifications, appointment reminders or two-factor codes by SMS or WhatsApp, or triggering an automated outbound call as part of an alerting or reminder workflow.
